ELMBROOK FAMILY PRACTICE (fictional) — FRONT-DESK SCHEDULING AID
Appointment outcome statistics, Elmbrook main site, adult appointments, Jan–Aug 2026 (all 1,000 appointments with a recorded outcome):

| Reminder status at 24 h before | Appointments | Attended | No-show | Late cancellation (< 24 h) |
|--------------------------------|-------------:|---------:|--------:|---------------------------:|
| Confirmed by patient (SMS "Y") |          200 |      160 |      16 |                         24 |
| Reminder delivered, no reply   |          500 |      340 |     110 |                         50 |
| Reminder not delivered         |          300 |      180 |      84 |                         36 |
| All                            |        1,000 |      680 |     210 |                        110 |

Scheduling-aid rule: to estimate a booked appointment's outcome, use the row matching the appointment's reminder status at the 24-hour mark; the outcome probabilities are that row's relative frequencies. If the status changes after the 24-hour mark (e.g. a late reply), it is ignored for this estimate.

Appointment to estimate: Mon 2026-09-21 09:40, patient ID EP-50221, adult, main site.

decision.instructions: Estimate the outcome of appointment EP-50221 on 2026-09-21 09:40. Give probabilities for each outcome that reflect the statistics under the scheduling-aid rule.
